verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for an auth service, since it could ship an AI assistant or agent interface, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never shows Supabase Auth accepting natural-language commands. The probes show only an llms.txt file, Markdown docs and an OpenAPI spec, which are developer building blocks that make docs and APIs readable by LLMs, not a natural-language control capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
